ELEMENTAL.notes: Sources disagree on Hit vs SP for first place: wow.gg puts SP first, Mobalytics and the Warcraft Tavern class overview put Hit first. I put HIT first until capped. Crit comes third because Elemental Fury raises crit damage and crits return mana. Haste is a new Forever gear stat: the Warcraft Tavern overview ranks it 2nd, the WT Elemental page ranks it last, and wow.gg leaves it out, so it sits below crit. Spell Pierce is also new (no stat key for it). Hit and crit are unified in Forever, so HIT=SHIT and CRIT=SCRIT; percent stats are per 1%. Water Shield gives no passive mp5 in Forever. Mindfulness (Resto tree) keeps 50% of regen while casting, which makes Spirit somewhat useful. Shamans have no Bloodlust; Rage of the Farseer is a personal cooldown instead. HEAL gets 0.25 because, reportedly, bonus healing also grants 1/3 as much damage in Forever; set it to 0 if the parser already counts that damage as SP. Leveling: Warcraft Tavern favours SP over Hit against level-equal mobs, and mana is tight early.

ENHANCEMENT.notes: Every source puts weapon damage first. Use a slow two-hander: Shamans cannot dual wield in Forever (wow.gg), and Flurry, Windfury and Stormstrike scale with weapon speed and damage. Then Hit > Expertise > Crit > Strength (wow.gg and WT both put Expertise next to or tied with Hit; it replaces the old weapon-skill bonuses). 1 STR = 2 AP; 14 AP = 1 DPS. In Forever, Mental Dexterity converts INT to AP (Warcraft Tavern: 1 INT = 1 AP, i.e. half a STR); one unverified comment says it was raised to 150%. Mental Quickness lets INT/SP scale spell damage. So INT sits just below STR, and the WT overview even ties them. Shaman AGI gives crit (1% per 20 AGI) but no AP, so AGI comes last (as in WT). Hit and crit are unified, so HIT=SHIT and CRIT=SCRIT; percent stats are per 1%. Haste exists, but no Enhancement guide ranks it. Windfury Totem is a permanent aura (no totem twisting). WT's priority still reflects the level 30 beta.

caps: No caps for healing. Hit does nothing for heals

RESTORATION.notes: The three sources agree only that Healing Power comes first. wow.gg: Crit > Int > Spirit > MP5. WT Resto page: Spirit > Int > Crit > Haste. WT class overview: Int > Haste > MP5 > Spirit > Crit. This order is a consensus by average rank. Forever-specific: Water Shield returns mana on heal crits but gives no passive mp5, Tidal Mastery adds 5% heal crit, HoTs can crit, and Riptide boosts Chain Heal, all of which lift crit. Warcraft Tavern calls Spirit the main regen stat in Forever, with Mindfulness keeping 50% of regen while casting, so SPI is slightly above MP5, though per point the two are close. Hit and crit are unified, so CRIT=SCRIT; percent stats are per 1%. SP (damage+healing) heals as well as HEAL. The WT Resto page still reflects the level 30 beta.
